item.title: Rallying Cry – August 3, 2026
item.description: A rare glimmer of hope in Myanmar as Aung San Suu Kyi connects with an outsider, 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' swings to the highest domestic opening ever, and a critically endangered langur makes a surprise return to Singapore’s Bukit Timah Nature Reserve!
